import json, subprocess
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def mk(pkts, service=(10,1), lanes=2, S=1, W=2, idle=1000, prob=None, rate=(1,1,10,10), pcap=512):
    cfg = {"slots":S,"window":W,"idle_timeout":idle,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
           "rate_num":rate[0],"rate_den":rate[1],"bucket_capacity":rate[2],"initial_tokens":rate[3],
           "pending_capacity":pcap,"lanes":lanes,"service":list(service),"fallback":0,
           "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":prob or [[65536]]}
    mdl = {"classes":2,"embedding_dim":1,
           "length_embedding":[[i] for i in range(16)],
           "gap_embedding":[[0] for _ in range(16)],
           "kernel":1,"conv_weights":[[[1,0]]],"conv_bias":[0],"conv_shift":[0],
           "dense_weights":[[0],[1]],"dense_bias":[1,0]}
    return {"version":1,"config":cfg,"model":mdl,
            "connections":[{"id":"a","slot":0,"label":1,"split":"eval"}],"packets":pkts}

# out-of-order feedback: job0 slow, job1 fast
pkts=[{"time":0,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0},
      {"time":1,"connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0},
      {"time":2,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":3,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":4,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":5,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":6,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0},
      {"time":7,"connection":"a","length":5,"draw":0}]
out = run(mk(pkts))
for j in out["jobs"]: print(j["id"], j["packet"], "lane",j["lane"], j["start"], j["done"], j["prediction"], j["status"])
print("forwards:", [p["forward"] for p in out["packets"]])
PYEOF
